'''jawajedi dark jawas and stuff''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[jawajedi]]
* '''Published:''' 20 July 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jawa Camp|Premiere-D-tatooinejawacamp.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Jawa Camp
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Tatooine Jawa Camp jawajedi DS.txt |Download]]
